summary: Samples TOP pixels into CHOP channels, supporting direct image conversion, UV-driven sampling, regions, rows, columns, channel selection, and GPU download options.
key_concepts: TOP to CHOP converts TOP image pixels into CHOP channels, placing RGBA color elements into separate channel streams.
It can extract a single pixel, rows, columns, rectangular regions, or a single set of channels for a whole image depending on parameters.
An optional CHOP input supplies U/V coordinates for sampling; the first channel is treated as U and the second as V.
Exclude NaN and Active Mask controls can skip pixels so they are not included in the CHOP output.
Depth TOP sources output only the depth value in the red channel.
Download Type can use a delayed GPU readback to avoid stalling rendering, but large image-to-CHOP conversions are still expensive.

key_params.name: downloadtype
key_params.note: Immediate slow or next-frame fast GPU download mode

key_params.name: nextframe
key_params.note: Download next frame with less render stall

key_params.name: crop
key_params.note: Pixel, row, column, block, or full image extraction

key_params.name: uvunits
key_params.note: Normalized or pixel UV coordinate units

common_gotchas: This is a GPU readback into CHOP data; full-frame conversion can be costly.
Depth TOPs output only red-channel depth data.
UV sampling requires exactly two input channels; the first is always treated as U and the second as V.
